instruction: Design a system that combines two given modules: a barrel shifter and a binary operation module. The system should separate a 16-bit input into two 8-bit outputs using the given barrel shifter module, which shifts the input to the right by 8 bits. Then, the system should use the given binary operation module to perform a bitwise AND operation on the two outputs. Additionally, the system should include an addictive control logic module that enables either the barrel shifter or the binary operation module based on a select input. The output should be the result of the selected module.
